# US Curtailment Tracker

> Daily solar and wind curtailment for CAISO, SPP, and ERCOT, with a 90-day history.

Part of [Kardashev Labs](https://kardashevlabs.org).

## What it shows

- Daily curtailed MWh by ISO (today, 30-day, 90-day trend)
- CAISO, SPP, ERCOT
- Morning refresh via kardashev-data

## Terms

- **Curtailment**: operators tell solar/wind to produce less because the grid cannot take the energy right then. High curtailment usually means congested lines, missing storage, or demand timed wrong.
- **Duck curve**: net load over a day after subtracting solar/wind. Midday solar dips the curve; evening demand ramps fast as solar fades. That ramp is why CAISO cares about curtailment and storage.
